name: Local IRIS FHIR Server
notes: Native local IRIS FHIR base used for the PIQITT namespace.
The namespace path is case-sensitive in this deployment and must be lower-case: piqitt.
Port 52773 is plain HTTP in this local IRIS deployment; do not attempt a TLS handshake against it.
GET /metadata is reachable without authentication, so the built-in default credential profile is none.
Select iris-basic explicitly for operations that require authentication.
Override locally with config/systems/local/iris-fhir-local.json if the local deployment changes.
